note: Rewritten from the English diagnostic characters of the Heterotermes malabaricus entry on p. 53 of Rathore & Tak (State Fauna Series 8: Fauna of Gujarat, Insecta: Isoptera); the original gives only a soldier section, and although Caste known records alates, soldiers and workers, the morphology of the worker and the alate is not given; measurement units in mm are kept verbatim.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier total body length 3.20—5.00 mm; head capsule nearly rectangular, distinctly longer than wide, head length (including the mandibles) 2.20—2.50 mm; antennae 12—14-segmented, segment 3 shortest; mandibles sabre-like, 0.70—0.93 mm long; postmentum clavate, the waist in the posterior third; pronotum flat, much wider than long.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule and labrum pale yellowish brown; mandibles dark brown, paler at the base. Total body length 3.20—5.00 mm. Head capsule nearly rectangular, distinctly longer than wide: head length (including the mandibles) 2.20—2.50 mm, head length (to the mandible base) 1.23—1.54 mm, head width 0.70—0.95 mm. Antennae 12—14-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Labrum nearly triangular, 0.35—0.43 mm long and 0.25—0.30 mm wide, with a transparent spine-like point at the tip. Mandibles sabre-like, 0.70—0.93 mm long, weakly incurved at the tip; the basal half of the inner margin of the left mandible with 3—4 denticles. Postmentum clavate, 0.82—1.25 mm long, greatest width (of the club) 0.32—0.43 mm, least width (of the waist) 0.15—0.20 mm, the waist in the posterior third. Pronotum flat, trapezoidal, much wider than long: length 0.33—0.50 mm, width 0.53—0.80 mm. Apical tibial spurs 3:2:2; tarsi 4-segmented; cerci 2-segmented.
